hold_candidate.semantics: tau_pd=kp*(qdes-physical_q) at zero joint velocity; current MuJoCo contact LP initializes the candidate; Isaac must validate it

contact_geometry.support_patch_semantics: exact_discrete_MuJoCo_contact_positions; their convex hull is contained in the contact-proximate collision sole hull

solver_report.inverse_dynamics: MuJoCo mj_inverse with constraints and frictionloss disabled; smooth net demand includes inertia/bias minus remaining passive damping/spring forces
solver_report.lp_objective_expression: min rho subject to tau<=rho*tau_hi and -tau<=rho*(-tau_lo)

non_claims: not an Isaac or PhysX closed-loop hold certificate
not a training policy bootstrap until the nominal hold gate passes
measured teacher validation does not claim mechanical admission
historical numerical seed model/hold claims are not inherited
